items.difficulty_reason: The counted proposition is the author proposition at source lines 1364-1366: every tautological instance of a propositional tautology, with sentence variables replaced by modal sentences, is valid at every world of every model. The author proof (1368-1377) runs the contrapositive: from a counterexample at a world it defines a propositional valuation recording the truth values of the substituted sentences at that world, invokes the unit's lemma that tautologies hold under every valuation, and concludes the substituted sentence itself is not a tautology. The construction of the mimicking valuation is the counted content.
